Oncall Bot: ALERT: Canary cluster eu-west-2a for release/2026-03-15-async-path is seeing elevated 5xx (502/504) on /v1/embeddings; error-rate 12% over 5m, latency P95 up 3x. Auto-fallback triggered to standard model variant. Paging eng-oncall.
Maya (eng-oncall): saw that, digging. any recent ff toggles?
Ashwin (eng-runtime): I flipped the new header-based routing FF (async-path: true) 6m ago for 20% canary. rolling back now if needed.
Jorge (sre): can we confirm customer impact? Telemetry shows errors correlated with requests that include header X-Async: 1.
Lucy (pm): customers using embeddings batch pipeline may see failures; notifying a few pilot customers on the list.
Maya (eng-oncall): Deploy Bot, what's the canary status?
Deploy Bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-15-async-path at 20% -> HEALTH CHECK: failing (5xx threshold breached). Auto-rollback not enabled.
Ashwin (eng-runtime): okay initiating manual kill-switch for feature flag. command: `ffctl set async-path false --env canary`
Ashwin (eng-runtime): executed `ffctl set async-path false --env canary` — responses: 20% -> 0% within ~12s.
Telemetry Bot: Telemetry note: error-rate dropped to 4% within 40s after FF disable, latency P95 back to baseline in 90s.
Maya (eng-oncall): good signal. leaving canary disabled. need postmortem? assign and scope.
Jorge (sre): record immediate mitigation: FF disable. Next steps: revert routing change in runtime config (it was a header-check micro-optim). If we re-enable, need staging soak and synthetic tests.
Lucy (pm): I'm going to open a customer incident update. We should include timeline and ETA for full rollback vs safe re-rollout.
Ashwin (eng-runtime): pushing a small runtime patch that tightens header parsing and adds a fallback path; will push to staging. command: `deploy-bot start release/2026-03-15-async-fix -> staging`
Deploy Bot: Deploy started to staging (release/2026-03-15-async-fix). smoke checks in 30s.
Maya (eng-oncall): anyone sees residual traffic hitting canary? I still see 2% routed — might be stuck proxies.
Jorge (sre): running `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/proxy-eu-west-2a` on canary proxy tier to pick up FF change.
Ashwin (eng-runtime): proxy restart done. verifying headers stripped at edge.
Telemetry Bot: After restart, routed canary traffic = 0.0%. error-rate cluster -> baseline.
Maya (eng-oncall): handing off to Ashwin for next 2h to validate staging fix and safe re-rollout plan. I'm off in 20. 
Ashwin (eng-runtime): taking handoff. will run additional synthetic load: `scripts/loadtest/embeddings_async.sh --rps 200 --duration 10m` then promote to 5% canary with step monitor.
Lucy (pm): noted. I'll draft customer message and share in #customer-status.
Jorge (sre): file quick incident ticket and tag for postmortem: INC-241030-async-canary. assign Maya (who triaged) + Ashwin + SRE oncall.
Maya (eng-oncall): created INC-241030-async-canary, adding logs and spans.
Ashwin (eng-runtime): one more note: root cause looks like a race in header parsing when both X-Async and legacy X-Mode present; fix adds deterministic precedence.
Maya (eng-oncall): thanks. if any regressions re-alert here. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: NOTE: If error-rate rises above 5% again for 3m, this thread will auto-pager escalation to oncall-1.
Maya (eng-oncall): closing active paging. handoff complete.
Ashwin (eng-runtime): will update here after staging smoke and first 5% promotion.
Lucy (pm): will send initial customer note in 10m.
Jorge (sre): leaving final postmortem checklist in the ticket.
Maya (eng-oncall): thanks all — good catch and fast rollback.
